requiredConditions: The pull request targets the correct originating work branch.
The head SHA has not changed after verification completed.
All required checks pass on the exact head SHA.
No .github/** change exists unless the task is an explicitly authorized workflow task.
No contract, migration, security, or finance change exists outside the frozen execution context.
No FLAKY result exists among required proofs.
No applicable NEEDS_EVIDENCE result remains for the task.
Baseline reconciliation ran and detected no unintended loss.
The work branch has not moved in a way that creates a logical conflict.

diagnosisRequirementNote: Product and journey registries, historical closure files, gap ledgers, capability graphs, and generated inventories are provisional discovery inputs. Before remediation, inspect the relevant current code, contracts, database behavior, runtime behavior, security boundaries, tests, and surfaces. Expand the diagnosis only where observed impact or risk requires it; registry-derived state never proves implementation or closure.
